title: Array as queue: live slots, draw, shift, append
requirements: Include an overview of all 52 slots, then a readable zoom of the first slots. Slots 0 through Count−1 are live; slots at or after Count are inactive, not necessarily zeroed.
Use Count=4 and illustrative cards [2♠,5♥,9♦,K♣]. Draw 2♠, copy 5♥→0,9♦→1,K♣→2, decrement Count to 3. The old last slot may remain stale.
Append A♠ at index Count=3 and then increment Count to 4. Preserve first-in/first-out semantics.
Count is an integer marking the live boundary, not a memory-address pointer. Keep “next to draw” at index 0.
beats: 0–4 s: live-slots — the array at rest, Count = 4 marking the live boundary; holds 4 s.
4–8.5 s: append — the card C lands in slot 4 (position Count); holds 2.2 s.
8.5–16.5 s: draw-shift — the first shift movement: H.Cards(0) = H.Cards(1); holds 2.6 s.
16.5–22.5 s: cost — every remaining card starts moving one slot forward at once; holds 3.2 s.
checks: No card is drawn from the array end.
An inactive tail slot is not presented as an extra live card.
Shift uses H.Cards(i - 1) = H.Cards(i), and the Count decrement happens afterward.
Both overview and draw/append segments have exportable hold frames.
copy:
Capacity: 52
Cards(0): next to draw
Live: 0 … Count − 1
Inactive: Count … 51
